Bihar Opposition Leader Questions Prashant Kishor Over Alleged 'Dustbin Scam'

Tejashwi Yadav, the leader of the opposition in Bihar, questioned political strategist Prashant Kishor about his alleged connection to Mangal Pandey, a name that surfaced in relation to a 'dustbin scam'. Yadav expressed anger over his name being dragged into the alleged scam. The specific details of the scam and the nature of Prashant Kishor's alleged involvement were not detailed in the coverage.
